relationships.subject: acetyl-L-carnitine
relationships.evidence_quote: Acetyl-l-carnitine induces acetylation of the p65 subunit of the NF-κB and H3 and H4 histones, thus increasing mGlu2 receptor expression and inducing analgesia.

relationships.subject: acetyl-L-carnitine
relationships.evidence_quote: Lastly, acetyl-l-carnitine treatment increased the levels of nerve growth factor (NGF) in the central nervous system of old rats

key_findings: Narrative review: acetyl-L-carnitine acts as an epigenetic regulator (p65/H3/H4 acetylation) upregulating mGlu2 receptor for lasting analgesia in neuropathic pain.
Clinical studies support benefit in peripheral neuropathies, with additive effect alongside pregabalin.
